'''Mootai''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Moorjhoni]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Moorjhone]] in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]]. When his brother [[Mas (Moorjhoni)|Mas]] tripped when preparing to [[Battle of Moorjhone|attack]] [[Ja'Boag]]'s mine, Mootai stopped to help him up. [[Darth Maul/Legends|Maul]] scolded him for doing so, and later during their preparations Maul [[Telekinesis/Legends|used]] [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to trip Mootai, and was happy to see Mas leave him behind.
